summary: A quick overview of what is visible to whom.

sections.title: What None, View and Edit mean

items: **None**: the part of the app is not shown at all.
**View**: you can read, but not add or change anything.
**Edit**: you can read, add and change.

blocks.text: Not sure what you can do? Open a part of the app. If you can only view it, a short message at the top says so.

Every signed-in member who can open any part of the app can see every member's profile photo, next to the name. The administrator sees it too. A signed-in account with no access at all does not. Photos are stored privately and are never on a public address: they can only be opened by a signed-in member. You decide what to show: remove your photo in [Profile settings](/profile) and your initial is shown instead.
